lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice sustaining a short fika conversation with follow-up, reaction, and clarification.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A realistic end-of-week fika where several small-talk skills appear together.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Maintaining a casual conversation with confidence.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik have a Friday fika, talk about the week, clarify one detail, and end with a weekend wish.

main_focus.name: conversation maintenance with follow-up moves
main_focus.description: Use short follow-up questions, reactions, and one clarification phrase to keep the exchange moving.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use conversation-maintenance moves naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: new advanced grammar as the main focus

vocabulary_target.theme: week review and weekend small talk
useful_chunks: Kan du ta det en gång till?
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Recycle chunks from the week while keeping the conversation coherent.

dialogue_shape.opening: They greet each other at Friday fika and ask about the week.
dialogue_shape.middle: A small update leads to reactions, a follow-up, and one clarification.
dialogue_shape.ending: They mention weekend plans and say goodbye naturally.

target_complexity.repetition: spiral review of small-talk and clarification chunks

focus: the overall mood of the week
what weekend plan or wish closes the conversation

sentence_focus: one sentence asking about the week
one sentence reacting to a small update
one sentence wishing someone a good weekend
